questions.question: How should the email decide which categories to keep?

options.label: Top by size
options.adds: Keep only the largest categories for the month and drop the rest.

options.label: Biggest changes
options.adds: Keep only the categories that changed most since last month.

options.label: Group into broader
options.adds: Merge the categories into a few broader groups instead of dropping any.

rewriteBeforeAnswers: The monthly email lists every category, and people stop reading halfway. Cut the list down so the email is short enough to read through. Only change which categories it shows; leave the rest of the email as it is, and tell me what you removed.
final: The monthly email lists every category, and people stop reading halfway. Cut the list down so the email is short enough to read through. Only change which categories it shows; leave the rest of the email as it is, and tell me what you removed. Keep only the largest categories for the month and drop the rest.
